column1: # RISC-V relocation types — DERIVED, do not edit.
# Produced by tools/gen-relocations.py from what riscv64-elf-as emits
# when a symbol cannot be resolved, read back with readelf -r. The
# number is the low byte of the `info` field, not a transcribed table.
# R_RISCV_BRANCH is absent because the assembler never emits one: a
# branch it cannot resolve is REWRITTEN into an inverted branch over a
# jump, in every form tried — another section, an undefined symbol,
# and with .option norelax. If it never leaves a branch for the linker
